title: Safe drinking water — how to treat and store water at home

source_name: internally authored — compiled from WHO & CDC guidance
notes: WHO's own drinking-water fact sheet is stats/policy-focused, not a household how-to (verified directly). This entry is compiled from CDC's household water treatment guidance and WHO's Household Water Treatment and Safe Storage program page — see https://www.cdc.gov/water-emergency/about/index.html and https://www.who.int/teams/environment-climate-change-and-health/water-sanitation-and-health/water-safety-and-quality/household-water-treatment-and-safe-storage. Not from a single WHO fact sheet — label accordingly in the UI, same as topic #12's team-authored disclosure. Deliberately does NOT claim to cover 'why drink enough water' (hydration importance) — that is a distinct, still-uncovered topic, flagged in progress-tracker.md rather than papered over with an example question this content can't actually answer.
